title: Identity derived homology comparison compatibility
statement: For every abelian C, integer n and bounded below derived object K, the homology map of the bounded-below inclusion preimage of the composite identity comparison and compatibility inverse equals the composite of the corresponding homology maps.

proof.text: Unfold the localization constructions and use the identity functor on complexes; the remaining equality follows from functoriality of homology and the fully faithful bounded-below inclusion.

lean.statement: theorem identityDerivedHomologyComparisonCompatibility {C : Type*} [Category C] [Abelian C] [HasDerivedCategory C] (n : ℤ) (K : DerivedCategory.Plus C) : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor C n).map (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.preimage ((mapDerivedCategoryIdIso C).inv.app K.obj ≫ (𝟭 C).mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompatibility.inv.app K)).hom = (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor C n).map ((mapDerivedCategoryIdIso C).inv.app K.obj) ≫ (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor C n).map ((𝟭 C).mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompatibility.inv.app K)
